title: Swedish Quake League
wikitext:
Swedish Quake League (SQL) was a [[4on4]] [[Team Deathmatch]] tournament run by [[Totte]] of [[Crusaders]]. It's official start-up was January 27th 1997, and it ran for six seasons until the spring of 1998. For the 2nd season, the league was divided in an LPB and a HPW division. Only Swedish clans were allowed to participate, but the three Norwegian clan [[The Vicious Vikings]], [[Spawn Clan]] and [[Clan Ragnarok]] were allowed to enter SQL's HPW division in September 1997 because they were the only HPW clans in Norway, and a league of three clans would be no fun. * '''Admin:''' [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Totte]] * '''Website:''' [http://web.archive.org/web/19980117191438/http://www.fragzone.se/sql/ Old home page (working)] * '''Rules:''' 4on4, 2x30, all official maps [http://web.archive.org/web/19980117202335/http://www.fragzone.se/sql/regler.html (all details here)]
